apps.name: Pocket Watch
apps.subtitle: Know where every rupee lives.
apps.localizedDescription:
An expense tracker built around one idea most finance apps get wrong: money isn't one abstract number — it physically lives in places. Your wallet, your bank, a drawer, eSewa.

Pocket Watch models those as Spaces, and every expense answers two questions: how much, and from which space. So the balances in the app always mirror the money in your pockets.

SPACES
Create, reorder, archive, and reconcile them against what you actually have, with a running history for each one.

FAST ENTRY
A custom in-app keypad. Amount, space, category, saved — in seconds. Expenses, income, and transfers between spaces.

BILLS & SUBSCRIPTIONS
Weekly, monthly, or yearly, with fixed or estimated amounts. Reminders arrive before the due date, and Mark paid confirms the real amount and source space, records the expense, and schedules the next cycle in a single action.

CALENDAR
The month at a glance with spend and due markers, plus per-day detail.

ANALYTICS
A category donut, spending over time, income versus expense, and which space the money left from — by week, month, or year.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Optional Face ID lock, CSV and JSON export, and data that never leaves your phone. No account, no cloud, no network calls.
apps.versionDescription: First release. Spaces, keypad-first expense entry, transfers, bills with reminders and one-tap mark-paid, month calendar, analytics, Face ID lock, and CSV/JSON export — all on-device.

apps.name: Dsgtify
apps.subtitle: Spotify with a Liquid Glass soul
apps.localizedDescription: A Liquid Glass mod for the Spotify iOS app. Keep Spotify's own screens with thoughtful tweaks (hide clutter, glass headers, AMOLED, accent colour), or switch on the full Redesign: glass tab bar, now playing bar, player and lyrics page, decluttered Home, tinted Search categories, one-title Library, and Music-style playlist/album/artist pages. Under either look: privacy switches, lyrics sources, gestures, blocked artists, remote flags, vibration, speed and pitch, and a Live Activity. Unsigned - your sideloading tool signs it with your own certificate.
